feet.title: Footwork diagram
feet.lefty: Viewed from above · right-handed fighter (L = left foot, R = right foot). If you're left-handed, do the opposite.
feet.ready: Fighting stance: left foot forward, right foot back.
feet.stance1: LEFT foot in front, toes turned slightly in.
feet.stance2: RIGHT foot behind, heel slightly raised.
feet.stance3: Feet wider than your shoulders, not on one straight line.
feet.fb1: ① Forward: the FRONT (left) foot steps first.
feet.fb2: ② The REAR (right) foot slides up the same distance.
feet.fb3: ③ Back: the REAR (right) foot moves back first.
feet.fb4: ④ The FRONT (left) foot follows. Back into your stance.
feet.sd1: ① To the left: the LEFT foot moves first.
feet.sd2: ② The RIGHT foot slides after it, same distance.
feet.sd3: ③ To the right: the RIGHT foot moves first.
feet.sd4: ④ The LEFT foot slides after it. Never cross your feet.
feet.pv1: ① Pivot on the ball of the FRONT foot; the REAR foot sweeps a quarter circle.
feet.pv2: ② Your whole body turns 90°. Pivot back and repeat.
feet.an1: ① The front foot steps out 45°, off the line of attack.
feet.an2: ② The rear foot follows; you're now at a safe angle.
feet.an3: Get off the line of attack, then get away.
